tools.name: discover
tools.description: Discover InfraPulse production capabilities and the universal execution contract without changing account state.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Create, inspect, or explicitly approve a private OAuth-bound InfraPulse connection. OAuth proves owner identity; requested InfraPulse operational scopes remain server-side and privileged scopes stay pending until the authenticated owner approves them.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Get a deterministic price quote before authorization or execution. This does not reserve credits or run provider work.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Create an idempotent prepaid authorization for a quoted operation. This may reserve private account credits but does not execute provider work.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Execute authorized provider work through InfraPulse. Requires a stable request_id and canonical authorization_id; may consume prepaid credits and change an external provider system.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an InfraPulse signed receipt by receipt_id or receipt object without changing account or provider state.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "quote" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Tool "execute" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
